en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing two adjacent buildings in a landscaped setting. On the left is a two‑storey residential-looking house with dormer windows in the roof and decorative shutters. On the right, partly screened by trees, stands a larger, more ornate building with arched windows and a small tower or belfry topped by a cross and clock. A curved driveway leads between the buildings through a garden with lawn and conifer trees. German captions are printed at the top over each building.
